sources.entry: AppIcons - Tool for generating icons in all sizes as required by macOS and iOS apps.

summary.one_liner: AppIcons is a tool that takes a 1024x1024 source image and generates the icon sizes required by macOS and iOS apps.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a tool that generates app icons in all sizes required by macOS and iOS apps. The user selects one 1024x1024 pixel image and the tool produces icons in normal and high resolution. The changelog says version 1.0 covered macOS icons, version 2.0 added iOS icons, and version 3.0 added export to an .xcassets folder. Later versions include code refactoring and an iOS icon bug fix. The README gives no further detail on the interface or output layout.
use_cases: create icons for an Xcode asset catalog
resize a 1024x1024 image into app icon set
notable: Takes a single 1024x1024 source image and produces all required icon sizes
Exports generated icons into an .xcassets folder (since version 3.0)
Covers both macOS and iOS icon requirements
caveats: README is brief and gives no installation or run instructions
Platform and language of the tool are not stated in the README
